Available Length: After Abel announced that he was working on "Chapter VI" in late 2018, the following year would see changes in the project's sound with long-time collaborator Illangelo returning to executive produce. At the same time, Abel and then girlfriend Bella Hadid would split up, and he would go on hiatus for a period of time. Around late 2019, Abel returned to social media, releasing two lead singles and sporting a radically different look with every music video and TV appearance in a red suit and bloody nose. 'After Hours' would release in March 2020 during the beginning of the COVID-19 lockdowns and would propel Abel to new heights on the charts for the remainder of the current decade.

Abel later went right to work music inspired by crucial events in 2020 like the pandemic and the Black Lives Matter protests. This project would later be scrapped for something more lighthearted and directly follow up 'After Hours'. At the 2021 BBMA's Abel teased the new project saying that "the After Hours are over and the dawn is coming". With production starting in November 2021, the music for the show was already being prepared, but not too long after, production issues had began to arise, pausing filming until May 2022. Before filming had paused Abel had began working closely with Mike Dean on his last minute Coachella 2022 headlining show with Swedish House Mafia, ultimately reworking the project's music.
